messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds later but I was the last person in the class and the closest seat was in the back of the classroom.

output.original_text: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds later but I was the last person in the class and the closest seat was in the back of the classroom.
output.joy: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, but I was so excited to be there, even if I was the last person in the class and the closest seat was in the back!
output.sadness: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, feeling alone as the last person in the class, forced to take a seat in the back, isolated from everyone.
output.fear: I nervously walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, becoming the last person in the room, with the closest seat awkwardly waiting for me all the way in the back.
output.anger: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, and I couldn’t believe I was the last person, forced to take a seat all the way in the back of the classroom!
output.surprise: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, shocked to find I was the last person there, and the closest seat was way at the back!
output.disgust: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, disgusted to be the last person there, and stuck with the most inconvenient seat in the back.
